info.comment: Flat vector food product: charter tuna. A navy oval tin can with a blue pull-ring, a simple fish pictogram in white on the lid. Corporate office aesthetic, clean geometric lines, no text, no letters, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, centered, crisp edges. Palette: navy #1B3A6B, bright blue #2F6FED, cool gray, white.
